name: jev-memory
description: Remembers the preferences you state in prompts: Jev (via stray) judges each prompt's sentences after the turn and saves lasting ones to .claude/jev-memory.md.

strayPath.title: stray binary
strayPath.description: Path to the stray CLI. Leave empty to use $HOME/.local/bin/stray.

takeOverMemory.title: Replace Claude Code's own memory
takeOverMemory.description: Drop Claude Code's built-in memory instructions so preferences are saved only by jev-memory.

playSound.title: Coin sound
playSound.description: Play a short coin sound when a preference is saved.
